{user?.firstName?.[0] || '👤'}
{user ? `${user.firstName} ${user.lastName}` : 'Utilisateur'}
{user?.role || 'Transporteur'}
{menuItems.map((item) => (
setCurrentPage(item.id)} > {item.icon} {item.label}
))}
